🚨 CORRECTION on PR-1 plan. My env hypothesis was wrong.

I cut the docblock branch, ran the test — STILL FAILED. Then ran with --testEnvironment=node explicitly — STILL FAILED. The env was never the root cause.

Real root cause (just dug in): tool-executor.test.ts:82-98 has jest.mock('fs', () => ({ promises: { ... } })) — the mock ONLY exports `promises`, no `existsSync`. Genkit's loadPromptFolder calls existsSync at module load (via body-tools → heartbeat-scheduler → runtime-snapshot → system → genkit) and gets undefined.

The fix is one line in the fs mock: add `existsSync: jest.fn(() => false)`. Not an env change. Not a docblock change.
